integrity: Universal mathematical argument and exact reproducible small-case checker; no independently certified proof or priority claim.
limitations: Applies only to m>n>=2 and the Duan--Zhang semigroup with increasing support maps and a single phase at the first arrow; uses their margin theorem, and does not assert independent priority or extension to other monomial semigroups.
title: Principal marginal congruences and exact phase classes in truncated monomial inverse semigroups
